title: Attention Manifolds: Steering or Blocking Language Models by Editing Learned B-Spline Surfaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.00257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In standard transformer attention, a source token sends the same value vector to every receiver. The query determines \emph{how much} to attend but not \emph{what} to extract. This work introduces \textbf{attention manifolds}: learned 2D B-spline surfaces $S_d(q_d, k_d)$ that modulate each value dimension based on the query-key interaction. Each surface is a tensor-product cubic B-spline initialized to zero, preserving pretrained behavior. Applied to LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct and 3B-Instruct, attention manifolds reduce WikiText-2 validation perplexity by 2--2.5 points with 0.3\% parameter overhead. Across 112 diverse prompts, surfaces change greedy-decoded output for 69\% (1B) to 83\% (3B) of cases, with the strongest effects on ambiguous and polysemous inputs (94--100\% change rate). translated_title: 注意力流形：通过编辑可学习的B样条曲面来引导或阻断语言模型
translated_abstract: 在标准的Transformer注意力机制中，一个源词元会向每个接收方发送相同的价值向量。查询决定了关注程度的多少，但无法决定提取什么样的内容。本工作提出了**注意力流形**：一种可学习的二维B样条曲面 S_d(q_d, k_d)，它基于查询-键的交互来调制每个价值维度。每个曲面是一个初始化为零的张量积三次B样条，从而保留预训练模型的原始行为。将注意力流形应用于LLaMA 3.2-1B-Instruct和3B-Instruct模型时，仅需0.3%的参数开销，即可将WikiText-2验证集困惑度降低2至2.5个点。在112个多样化的提示中，曲面改变了贪婪解码输出的69%（1B模型）至83%（3B模型），其中对模糊和多义输入的影响最为强烈（变化率达94-100%）。这些曲面还能提升输出质量：纠正事实错误（如“CAP定理有三个主要组成部分”→“不可能保证……”（原文摘要在此处截断））
tldr: 本文提出“注意力流形”这一新机制，利用可学习的B样条曲面根据查询-键交互动态调制注意力价值向量，仅以0.3%的参数开销即可显著降低语言模型困惑度，并能有效引导或阻断模型输出、纠正事实错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "attention manifolds"—learnable B-spline surfaces that modulate attention value dimensions based on query-key interaction—achieving significant perplexity reduction with only 0.3% parameter overhead while effectively steering or blocking language model outputs and correcting factual errors.
